description: This file defines the ViewModulefields class responsible for rendering and managing the module fields view within the SuiteCRM module builder interface. It handles displaying module fields, loading language files, processing field definitions, and integrating with the Ajax interface for dynamic content loading.

classes.name: ViewModulefields
classes.description: A view class that manages the display and editing of module fields in the SuiteCRM module builder interface.

methods.name: _getModuleTitleParams
methods.description: Returns the title parameters for the module view.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Main method to render the module fields view, handling both studio and package modes.

methods.name: loadPackageHelp
methods.description: Sets help context for the loaded package.

methods.name: cullFields
methods.description: Removes certain fields from the field definitions that are not needed for display.

methods.name: isValidStudioField
methods.description: Determines if a given field definition is valid for display/edit in the studio interface.
